A '''neocelk''' was an article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]]. Some [[Swooper/Legends|members]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba Desilijic Tiure's]] [[Gizz's Gang|swoop gang]] wore [[Color/Legends|blue]] neocelks.
